If `Sum` is built with a different baseline than other tall operators, that gives a precise implementation target and reduces the risk of changing shared helpers unnecessarily.

Also strengthen the plan by checking whether the bug is in `Sum._pretty` versus generic horizontal composition in `prettyForm.__add__`/binding methods. A quick way to frame this in the plan is: first confirm whether a standalone `Sum(...)` already has its baseline on the summand row before it is combined into `Add`.
